newsitem.title: USA: Texaco won't confirm report of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Texaco won't confirm report of settlement.

text.p: Texaco Inc said on Friday afternoon that it would neither confirm nor deny a report by CNN television that the company had settled a racial discrimination lawsuit.

"I cannot confirm that," company spokesman Yorick Fonseca said from the company's headquarters in White Plains. "That information has a different source" and did not come from the company. CNN reported the company settled the lawsuit, which has led to calls by black civil rights leaders to boycott Texaco stations and to begin picketing the company on Saturday.
The civil rights leaders, including Jesse Jackson and Al Sharpton, met earlier this week with Texaco Chairman and Chief Executive Peter Bijur.
After the meeting, Bijur told reporters he was involved in negotiations for a possible settlement, but would not say when he hoped one would be reached.
